dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
Tate is an incredibly affectionate and cuddly kitty who loves being close to her human. She would happily spend the entire day sitting on your lap, snuggling beside you, or making the sweetest little biscuits right on your tummy. She loves attention, enjoys being petted, and will often seek you out just to be near you. She's the kind of cat who makes sure you're never alone!

Tate can be a little timid and shy at first, so she'll need some patience and time to settle into a new home. Once she feels safe and comfortable, her affectionate personality really shines. She also has a bit of a sassy side and isn't afraid to let you know when she needs some personal space. She knows what she likes and isn't shy about communicating it!

Tate is a sweet, loving companion with a big personality, a cuddly nature, and plenty of character. Give her a little time, a cozy spot, and lots of love, and she'll reward you with endless companionship, purrs, and tummy biscuits.
dog.name: Tate
